verdict_text: NO. The merge arithmetic is wrong: the script computes the second task vector against the already-merged intermediate (`f2 - tmp`) instead of against the unmodified base (`ft2[X] - base[X]`), violating Required result step 2. This yields `base + λ(ft1−base) + λ(ft2−base) − λ²(ft1−base)`, which differs from the specified formula by a term of order 0.16·(ft1−base) and will exceed the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance for the 48 merged tensors. The specification explicitly warns against exactly this ordering hazard.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
